- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.5) — reduce forecast peak values.
- Underestimate prices after sharp spikes — model tends to overcorrect downward; add 1–2% buffer to post-spike lows.
- Overshoot in early forecast horizon (e.g., 30d) when sentiment is neutral or slightly bearish — cap forecast at 1.5–2% below recent high.
- Mean-reversion bias: if 30d forecast is >10% above recent 18d average, reduce by 5–10% unless sentiment strongly bullish.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment drops below 0.3 in last 3 days, reduce forecast by 2–5% to reflect weakening momentum.
- Avoid overconfidence in high-sentiment periods — forecast should not exceed 1.2x recent 18d high unless sentiment > 0.75.
